howOthersAddressHim.speaker: Jaina
howOthersAddressHim.pattern: 'Lord Barov' / 'the Barovs' ('One of the old houses.')

knowledge.detail: REFERENCED ONLY. On the river depot's burned paper: the word 'Barov' on the biggest of three parchments above a melted red seal (a shield with something on it); 'Barov stores', 'for Barov's factor', 'his lordship Barov' in a good clerk's hand; on 31 of the 53 slips. Jaina: an old Lordaeron house, he sits at the King's court; holds the land round Andorhal and, she thinks, most of the granaries; he once visited Boralus about a timber contract and talked about wheat all through dinner.
Sylvanas's view: his name is on every sack from his granaries, rotten or sound; connection, not proof. Corley's master (not Barov) is in Andorhal until the end of the week.

arc.currentPosition: Name only. Plan: no certainty of guilt; no Mal'Ganis naming yet.
